SELECT DISTINCT    CLCL.CLCL_ID 	, CLCL.MEME_CK 	, CLCL.CLCL_LOW_SVC_DT 	, CLCL.CLCL_HIGH_SVC_DT 	, CLCL.CLCL_TOT_CHG 	, CLCL.CLCL_TOT_PAYABLE 	, CLCL.PRPR_ID 	, PRPR.PRPR_NAME 	, PRPR.PRPR_NPI AS NPI_ID 	, PRPR.MCTN_ID AS TAX_ID 	, MEME.MEME_MEDCD_NO                    ,CDML.RCRC_ID AS REV_CD 	, APR.APRAI_ID_NO AS DADS 	,'' AS QU5_FALLOUT FROM  	FACETS.CMC_CLCL_CLAIM CLCL 	INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_CDML_CL_LINE CDML 	  ON CLCL.CLCL_ID = CDML.CLCL_ID 	INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_CLHP_HOSP CLHP 	  ON CLCL.CLCL_ID = CLHP.CLCL_ID 	INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_PRPR_PROV PRPR 	  ON CLCL.PRPR_ID = PRPR.PRPR_ID 	LEFT OUTER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME 	  ON CLCL.MEME_CK = MEME.MEME_CK AND CLCL.GRGR_CK = MEME.GRGR_CK 	LEFT OUTER JOIN AGP.AGP_APRAI_ALT_ID  APR 	  ON CLCL.PRPR_ID = APR.PRPR_ID AND APR.APRAI_ISSUE_STATE = 'TX' AND APR.APRAI_ID_TYPE = 'NHF' WHERE  	CLCL.GRGR_CK = 4 	AND CLCL.CLCL_CUR_STS IN ('11','15','01')  	AND CLCL.CSPI_ID LIKE '%NF%' 	AND (CDML.RCRC_ID IN ('0100','0101','0230','0410')                     AND CDML.CDML_SEQ_NO = 1) 	AND CLCL.CLCL_INPUT_DT > TO_DATE('20150301','YYYYMMDD')

SELECT        TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH.R_INT_DTL_CLENT_MED_NUM, MAX(UMI_AUTH_VENDOR_BATCH.FILE_DT) AS PROCDT FROM            AGP.TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH, AGP.UMI_AUTH_VENDOR_BATCH UMI_AUTH_VENDOR_BATCH,                           AGP.AGP_TXNF_BASE CLAIMS,AGP.AGP_TXNF_REV_XWALK XWALK WHERE               TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH.BATCH_NO = UMI_AUTH_VENDOR_BATCH.BATCH_NO AND                           TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH.R_INT_DTL_CLENT_MED_NUM = CLAIMS.MEME_MEDCD_NO AND                           TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH.R_INT_DTL_CLENT_AUTH_BEGIN_IDX <= CLAIMS.CLCL_LOW_SVC_DT AND                           TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH.R_INT_DTL_SERV_AUTH_END_IDX >= CLAIMS.CLCL_HIGH_SVC_DT AND                           (TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH.R_INT_DTL_REC_TYPE IN ('U', 'N')) AND (TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH.R_INT_DTL_STATUS = 'A') AND                           (TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH."LOB = 'MCD')                           AND (TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH.R_INT_DTL_CLENT_AUTH_SERV_GRP = '1')                          AND CLAIMS.REV_CD = XWALK.REV_CD                          AND (TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH.R_INT_DTL_CLENT_AUTH_SERV_CD = XWALK.SVC_CD)                          AND                           (TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH.R_INT_DTL_SPECFIC_KEY NOT IN                              (SELECT DISTINCT TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH_1.R_INT_DTL_SPECFIC_KEY                                FROM            AGP.TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH,                                                           AGP.TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH_1                                WHERE        TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH.R_INT_DTL_CLENT_MED_NUM = TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH_1.R_INT_DTL_CLENT_MED_NUM AND                                                           TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH.R_INT_DTL_CLENT_AUTH_SERV_PRV = TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH_1.R_INT_DTL_CLENT_AUTH_SERV_PRV AND                                                           TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH.R_INT_DTL_CLENT_AUTH_BEGIN_DT = TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH_1.R_INT_DTL_CLENT_AUTH_BEGIN_DT AND                                                           TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH.R_INT_DTL_SERV_AUTH_END_DT = TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH_1.R_INT_DTL_SERV_AUTH_END_DT AND                                                           (TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH.R_INT_DTL_REC_TYPE IN ('U', 'N')) AND (TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH.R_INT_DTL_STATUS = 'C') AND                                                           (TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH_1.R_INT_DTL_STATUS <> 'C'))) AND (UMI_AUTH_VENDOR_BATCH.VENDOR_CD = 'SAS') GROUP BY TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH.R_INT_DTL_CLENT_MED_NUM

SELECT A.* FROM ( 	SELECT  TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH.BATCH_NO 		, TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH.R_INT_DTL_REC_ID 		, TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH.R_INT_DTL_REC_TYPE 		, TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH.R_INT_DTL_SPECFIC_KEY 		, TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH.R_INT_DTL_CLENT_MED_NUM 		, TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH.R_INT_DTL_CLENT_AUTH_SERV_PRV 		, TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH.REC_TYPE 		, TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH.ERROR_CD 		, TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH.R_INT_DTL_CLENT_AUTH_BEGIN_IDX 		, TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH.R_INT_DTL_SERV_AUTH_END_IDX 		, UMI_AUTH_VENDOR_BATCH.FILE_DT AS PROCDT 		, TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH.R_INT_DTL_CLENT_AUTH_SERV_GRP 		, CLAIMS.CLCL_ID 		, CLAIMS.CLCL_LOW_SVC_DT 		, CLAIMS.CLCL_HIGH_SVC_DT 	FROM  		AGP.TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH 		INNER JOIN 		AGP.UMI_AUTH_VENDOR_BATCH UMI_AUTH_VENDOR_BATCH 		ON (TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH.BATCH_NO = UMI_AUTH_VENDOR_BATCH.BATCH_NO)  		INNER JOIN 		AGP.AGP_TXNF_BASE CLAIMS 		ON TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH.R_INT_DTL_CLENT_MED_NUM = CLAIMS.MEME_MEDCD_NO AND TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH.R_INT_DTL_CLENT_AUTH_SERV_PRV = CLAIMS.DADS 		AND (TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH.R_INT_DTL_CLENT_AUTH_BEGIN_IDX <= CLAIMS.CLCL_LOW_SVC_DT AND TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH.R_INT_DTL_SERV_AUTH_END_IDX >= CLAIMS.CLCL_HIGH_SVC_DT) 	WHERE  		  TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH.R_INT_DTL_REC_TYPE IN ('U', 'N') 	  AND TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH.R_INT_DTL_STATUS = 'A' 	  AND TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH.LOB = 'MCD' 	  AND TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH.R_INT_DTL_CLENT_AUTH_SERV_GRP = '1' 		AND TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH.R_INT_DTL_CLENT_AUTH_SERV_CD = '1' 	  AND TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH.R_INT_DTL_SPECFIC_KEY NOT IN( SELECT DISTINCT TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH_1.R_INT_DTL_SPECFIC_KEY 																	FROM AGP.TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH INNER JOIN AGP.TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH_1 																			ON TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH.R_INT_DTL_CLENT_MED_NUM = TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH_1.R_INT_DTL_CLENT_MED_NUM	AND TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH.R_INT_DTL_CLENT_AUTH_SERV_PRV = TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH_1.R_INT_DTL_CLENT_AUTH_SERV_PRV	AND TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH.R_INT_DTL_CLENT_AUTH_BEGIN_DT = TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH_1.R_INT_DTL_CLENT_AUTH_BEGIN_DT	AND TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH.R_INT_DTL_SERV_AUTH_END_DT = TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH_1.R_INT_DTL_SERV_AUTH_END_DT 																	WHERE TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH.R_INT_DTL_REC_TYPE IN ('U', 'N') 																		AND TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH.R_INT_DTL_STATUS = 'C' 																		AND TXNF_SRVAUTH_450_SERVAUTH_1.R_INT_DTL_STATUS <> 'C' 																   ) )  A INNER JOIN AGP.AGP_TXNF_MAX_BATCH MXBAT ON A.R_INT_DTL_CLENT_MED_NUM = MXBAT.R_INT_DTL_CLENT_MED_NUM AND A.PROCDT = MXBAT.PROCDT

SELECT  LVLSRV.R_INT_LSRV_CLENT_MED_NUM 	, MAX(UMI_AUTH_VENDOR_BATCH.FILE_DT) AS PROCDT FROM  	AGP.TXNF_SRVAUTH_430_LEVELSERVICE LVLSRV 	INNER JOIN 	AGP.UMI_AUTH_VENDOR_BATCH UMI_AUTH_VENDOR_BATCH 	ON (LVLSRV.BATCH_NO = UMI_AUTH_VENDOR_BATCH.BATCH_NO)  	INNER JOIN 	AGP.AGP_TXNF_450NF AUTH 	ON LVLSRV.R_INT_LSRV_CLENT_MED_NUM = AUTH.R_INT_DTL_CLENT_MED_NUM  	AND LVLSRV.R_INT_LSRV_CLENT_PROV_NUM = AUTH.R_INT_DTL_CLENT_AUTH_SERV_PRV 	AND (LVLSRV.R_INT_LSRV_LVLSERV_BEGIN_IDX >= AUTH.R_INT_DTL_CLENT_AUTH_BEGIN_IDX AND LVLSRV.R_INT_LSRV_LVLSERV_END_IDX <= AUTH.R_INT_DTL_SERV_AUTH_END_IDX) 	AND (AUTH.CLCL_LOW_SVC_DT >= LVLSRV.R_INT_LSRV_LVLSERV_BEGIN_IDX AND AUTH.CLCL_HIGH_SVC_DT <= LVLSRV.R_INT_LSRV_LVLSERV_END_IDX) WHERE  LVLSRV.R_INT_LSRV_LVLSERV_STATUS = 'A' AND LVLSRV.LOB = 'MCD' AND LVLSRV.R_INT_LSRV_LVLSERV_TYPE = 'RG' AND LVLSRV.R_INT_LSRV_LVLSERV_STATUS NOT IN(SELECT DISTINCT LVLSERV1.R_INT_DTL_SPECFIC_KEY                                                FROM AGP.TXNF_SRVAUTH_430_LEVELSERVICE LVLSERV                                                   INNER JOIN  AGP.TXNF_SRVAUTH_430_LEVELSERVICE LVLSERV1                                                   ON (LVLSERV.R_INT_LSRV_CLENT_MED_NUM = LVLSERV1.R_INT_LSRV_CLENT_MED_NUM)	AND (LVLSERV.R_INT_LSRV_CLENT_PROV_NUM = LVLSERV1.R_INT_LSRV_CLENT_PROV_NUM)	AND (LVLSERV.R_INT_LSRV_LVLSERV_BEGIN_DT = LVLSERV1.R_INT_LSRV_LVLSERV_BEGIN_DT)	AND (LVLSERV.R_INT_LSRV_LVLSERV_END_DT = LVLSERV1.R_INT_LSRV_LVLSERV_END_DT)                                                 WHERE (LVLSERV.R_INT_LSRV_REC_TYPE IN ('U', 'N'))                                                   AND (LVLSERV.R_INT_LSRV_LVLSERV_STATUS = 'C')                                                   AND (LVLSERV1.R_INT_LSRV_LVLSERV_STATUS <> 'C')                                                 ) AND  (LVLSRV.ERROR_CD = '' OR LVLSRV.ERROR_CD IS NULL) AND UMI_AUTH_VENDOR_BATCH.VENDOR_CD = 'SAS' GROUP BY  	LVLSRV.R_INT_LSRV_CLENT_MED_NUM

SELECT A.* FROM ( 	SELECT 	LVLSRV.BATCH_NO 	,LVLSRV.R_INT_LSRV_REC_ID 	,LVLSRV.R_INT_LSRV_REC_TYPE 	,LVLSRV.R_INT_DTL_SPECFIC_KEY 	,LVLSRV.R_INT_LSRV_CLENT_MED_NUM 	,LVLSRV.R_INT_LSRV_CLENT_PROV_NUM 	,LVLSRV.REC_TYPE 	,LVLSRV.ERROR_CD 	,LVLSRV.R_INT_LSRV_LVLSERV 	,LVLSRV.R_INT_LSRV_LVLSERV_BEGIN_IDX 	,LVLSRV.R_INT_LSRV_LVLSERV_END_IDX 	,UMI_AUTH_VENDOR_BATCH.FILE_DT AS PROCDT 	,AUTH.CLCL_ID 	,AUTH.CLCL_LOW_SVC_DT 	,AUTH.CLCL_HIGH_SVC_DT 	FROM  		AGP.TXNF_SRVAUTH_430_LEVELSERVICE LVLSRV 		INNER JOIN 		AGP.UMI_AUTH_VENDOR_BATCH UMI_AUTH_VENDOR_BATCH 		ON (LVLSRV.BATCH_NO = UMI_AUTH_VENDOR_BATCH.BATCH_NO)  		INNER JOIN 		AGP.AGP_TXNF_450NF AUTH 		ON LVLSRV.R_INT_LSRV_CLENT_MED_NUM = AUTH.R_INT_DTL_CLENT_MED_NUM  		AND LVLSRV.R_INT_LSRV_CLENT_PROV_NUM = AUTH.R_INT_DTL_CLENT_AUTH_SERV_PRV 		AND (LVLSRV.R_INT_LSRV_LVLSERV_BEGIN_IDX >= AUTH.R_INT_DTL_CLENT_AUTH_BEGIN_IDX AND LVLSRV.R_INT_LSRV_LVLSERV_END_IDX <= AUTH.R_INT_DTL_SERV_AUTH_END_IDX) 		AND (AUTH.CLCL_LOW_SVC_DT >= LVLSRV.R_INT_LSRV_LVLSERV_BEGIN_IDX AND AUTH.CLCL_HIGH_SVC_DT <= LVLSRV.R_INT_LSRV_LVLSERV_END_IDX) 	WHERE  	LVLSRV.R_INT_LSRV_LVLSERV_STATUS = 'A' 	AND LVLSRV.LOB = 'MCD' 	AND LVLSRV.R_INT_LSRV_LVLSERV_TYPE = 'RG' 	AND LVLSRV.R_INT_LSRV_LVLSERV_STATUS NOT IN(SELECT DISTINCT LVLSERV1.R_INT_DTL_SPECFIC_KEY 												   FROM AGP.TXNF_SRVAUTH_430_LEVELSERVICE LVLSERV 													  INNER JOIN  AGP.TXNF_SRVAUTH_430_LEVELSERVICE LVLSERV1 													  ON (LVLSERV.R_INT_LSRV_CLENT_MED_NUM = LVLSERV1.R_INT_LSRV_CLENT_MED_NUM)	AND (LVLSERV.R_INT_LSRV_CLENT_PROV_NUM = LVLSERV1.R_INT_LSRV_CLENT_PROV_NUM)	AND (LVLSERV.R_INT_LSRV_LVLSERV_BEGIN_DT = LVLSERV1.R_INT_LSRV_LVLSERV_BEGIN_DT)	AND (LVLSERV.R_INT_LSRV_LVLSERV_END_DT = LVLSERV1.R_INT_LSRV_LVLSERV_END_DT)  												   WHERE (LVLSERV.R_INT_LSRV_REC_TYPE IN ('U', 'N')) 												   													  AND (LVLSERV.R_INT_LSRV_LVLSERV_STATUS = 'C') 													  AND (LVLSERV1.R_INT_LSRV_LVLSERV_STATUS <> 'C') 													) 	AND  (LVLSRV.ERROR_CD = '' OR LVLSRV.ERROR_CD IS NULL) )  A INNER JOIN AGP.AGP_TXNF_MAX_BATCH_SERV  MXBAT ON A.R_INT_LSRV_CLENT_MED_NUM = MXBAT.R_INT_LSRV_CLENT_MED_NUM  AND A.PROCDT = MXBAT.PROCDT

SELECT QSERV.* , QCLAIM.DADS , QCLAIM.TAX_ID , QCLAIM.NPI_ID , QCLAIM.CLCL_TOT_CHG , QCLAIM.CLCL_TOT_PAYABLE , CAST('' AS VARCHAR(20)) AS RATE_KEY , CAST('' AS VARCHAR(5)) AS BILL_CD , CAST('0.0000' AS NUMERIC(13,4)) AS NSVM_ALLOW FROM AGP.AGP_TXNF_430NF QSERV LEFT OUTER JOIN AGP.AGP_TXNF_BASE QCLAIM ON QSERV.CLCL_ID = QCLAIM.CLCL_ID
